storyline.real: Alonso's grid penalty hands Hamilton pole, and he leads every lap. Räikkönen passes Heidfeld at the start and follows the McLaren all race: both stop on lap 19, and Räikkönen stops again four laps before Hamilton, but never gets back in front. He closes to half a second by lap 57 and finishes 0.715 s behind.
storyline.headline: Räikkönen beats Hamilton to the Hungaroring win

hidden.label: Win without pushing for a single lap

eras.briefing: Hungaroring, 2007. Alonso's grid penalty hands Hamilton pole. You run Räikkönen's Ferrari, second and 4.6 s behind the McLaren after 16 laps, with Heidfeld's BMW 8.3 s further back. Two stops each, and the fuel you take at the first decides the order. Win it.
